exposure: lateral decubitus position during spinal anesthesia induction
sitting position during spinal anesthesia induction
outcome: duration of sensory and motor block
cohort: 76 healthy pregnant women undergoing caesarean section
finding: Induction of spinal anesthesia in the lateral decubitus position during caesarean section resulted in lower incidence of hypotension, bradycardia, and vasopressor consumption compared to the sitting position.
